title: Canonical restricted derived-Hom evaluation map
statement: For schemes $S,Y$, $h:Y\to S$, $U\in S_{et}$, an abelian etale sheaf $F$ and $p\in\mathbb N$, let $A$ be the raw derived-Hom group of [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison] and $R$ the restricted cohomology of [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology]. Construct an additive morphism $c:A\to R$ as follows: put $V=U\times_S Y$ and $r:V\to Y$, and pull the represented identity section of the free abelian sheaf on $U$ back using the unit of $h^*\dashv h_*$. Identify this section with an element of $H^0(R\Gamma(V,r^*h^*\mathbb Z[U][0]))$. Apply $H^0(R\Gamma(V,r^*(-)))$ to a raw morphism $t:h^*\mathbb Z[U][0]\to F[0][p]$, evaluate at that element, and use the single-complex and shift isomorphisms to obtain an element of $R$. This construction chooses no arbitrary witness.
